column2: What does a family tree’s password protect?
column3: Settings → 🔐 Password for this family tree (or 🌳 My family trees → 🔐): you must type it to open this family tree in the app, and it locks again after 15 minutes without any activity (5 min, 1 h or never), when the app closes and when you change family tree. Its backups are always encrypted with this password (AES-256). But the file itself is not encrypted: someone who copies it can read it with other software. For that, encrypt your computer’s disk (FileVault on Mac, BitLocker on Windows). Forgotten password: there is no back door, the family tree no longer opens in the app.

Settings → 📜 Who saw what (or, in an estate file, 🕓 Log → “📜 Who saw this file”): every file opening (once per session), print or PDF, export, mail merge letter and every password attempt, with the date and the computer’s name. Nothing in it can be changed or erased; lines older than 12 months go away by themselves (adjustable: 3 months to keep everything, and that is recorded). Never an address, an amount or a password. ⤓ CSV to export it.
